abstract_statement: Spatial Ground canonically expresses and preserves which canonical Survey space is BitPangea World-space.
World-space is contained in, but not definitionally identical with, canonical Survey space.
Membership is total, closed two-valued, and deterministic for every valid Survey location.
Exactly one canonical World-space definition governs.
Membership depends only on the canonical definition and inherited Survey truth, not hidden or operational inputs.
Adopted membership is permanent.
Canonical meaning is representation-independent.
Spatial Ground remains subordinate to applicable constitutional sources.
BitPangea has one singular canonical World-space.
Canonical World-space is non-empty.
Canonical World-space is connected under inherited Survey topology.
Canonical World-space conforms to constitutional Extent.
One primary authority/form exists for each semantic element.
The definition is reconstructably closed from canonical rules and inputs.
The definition is finitely expressible and membership is decidable.
Definition validity is decidable.
Representation equivalence is decidable where applicable.
Membership is closed under supported Survey refinement.
Spatial Ground references but does not redefine the Foundational Survey Fabric.
Equal Survey references receive the same Ground answer.
Ground creates no finer spatial distinction than inherited Survey truth supports.
Survey dependencies are declared and deficiencies route to the owning architecture.
Ground-native meaning is membership and nothing else.
Ground's responsibility set is closed; scope change is governed.
The canonical limit is where membership changes.
Ground supplies exact stable membership upward.
Ground guarantees no higher-layer eligibility, ownership, terrain, region, parcel, or experiential meaning.
Higher layers cannot alter membership; deficiencies return to the owning layer.
Canonical status arises only from recorded adoption.
Governance events establish record status but never become membership inputs.
No Ground or Atlas mechanism may alter established World-space.
Correction, supersession, model replacement, and scope change are governed and cannot alter established membership.
Preservation and Conformance originate no Ground truth.
